title: Shared Moments
meta_description: Find the perfect Panama City Beach, FL vacation rental at Shared Moments, a luxury 7-bed, 8-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 15 guests, this home house offers all the luxury amenities Panama City Beach has to offer. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Gulf Front - Private beach walkover - Access to community pools (Bellview Park and Lake Carillon Pool (East side) are heated November - May 1) - Elevator - Hot Tub - 6 adult Bikes, Community Golf Cart, Paddleboards and Kayaks - Complimentary beach setup - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 *Guests are required to complete Carillon registration online. The current fee is $37.50 + taxes and fees per vehicle for the duration of the stay (subject to change). Experience refined coastal living in this luxury Gulf-front retreat, thoughtfully designed for comfort, style, and unforgettable beachfront moments. With direct Gulf frontage and a private beach walkover, this home offers seamless access to sugar-white sands and emerald waters, just steps from your door. Inside, the residence blends upscale finishes with inviting spaces across multiple levels, all easily accessible by a private elevator. After a day at the beach, unwind in the hot tub, take a dip in the community pools, or explore the area with six adult bikes, paddleboards, and kayaks provided for your enjoyment. Whether you’re gathering for a family getaway or a luxury beach escape with friends, this Gulf-front home delivers an elevated coastal experience with exceptional amenities, generous sleeping accommodations, and unmatched beachfront access. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Bunkroom w/ Twin over Full Bed - 1/2 Bathroom Second Floor - Queen Murphy Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - 1/2 Bathroom Third Floor - Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate - Queen Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Tub/Combo Carriage House - Queen bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Bunkroom w/ Two Twin Bunks, Shared Bathroom, Shower Only
